subject: Aria Coleman — virtual onsite: panel order & feedback window
messages:
From: Sophie Tran <sophie@hirewell.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate: Aria Coleman — availability for virtual onsite

Hi Ben,

Hope you’re well. I’m coordinating a virtual onsite for Aria Coleman (senior infra SRE candidate) and want to lock a multi-slot day next week. Aria is NY-based (ET) and is available TUE 10/5 and THU 10/7 between 10:00–15:00 ET.

Hiring manager wants a 4–5 interview loop: system design, production debugging/incident, cross-team collaboration/culture, hiring manager deep-dive and a 30–40m debrief block for the interviewers. Would Redwood prefer morning-heavy sequencing (design first) or interleaved shorter blocks?

Attached is Aria’s resume. Can you confirm preferred sequencing and which internal folks I should loop in so we can send a candidate-confirm invite?

Thanks,
Sophie
Sophie Tran | Senior Recruiter, HireWell
T: 415-555-0182
Attachment: aria_coleman_resume.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tran <sophie@hirewell.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate: Aria Coleman — availability for virtual onsite

Sophie — thanks for the note and the resume. Looping Laura (hiring manager partner) and Logan (interviewer pool lead) to propose sequencing. A couple constraints on our side:

- We prefer the heavier system-design early in the day to give candidates the freshest focus.
- We try to keep contiguous windows under 3.5 hours for virtual fatigue and include explicit 20-minute breaks.
- Debrief ownership: we normally reserve the final 30–40m as an async/combined docable time; if the hiring manager wants synchronous, we can do a 30m live debrief immediately after the loop.

Proposal (ET):
- 10:00–10:50 — System design (lead: Logan)
- 11:10–11:40 — Prod debugging / incident analysis (interviewer A)
- 12:10–12:40 — Collaboration / cross-team (interviewer B)
- 14:00–14:40 — Hiring manager deep-dive (Laura)
- 15:00–15:30 — Synchronous debrief (optional) OR 48hr async feedback window with shared doc

If that works for Aria’s windows we can firm it. I attached a quick calendar template and we can iterate.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Sophie Tran <sophie@hirewell.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-03T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate: Aria Coleman — availability for virtual onsite

Thanks — this looks good. A couple small edits and clarifications:

- Swap the 11:10 slot to 11:05–11:35 so we keep consistent 20m break windows.
- Could we shorten the hiring manager block to 30m (14:00–14:30) and use 14:30–15:00 as buffer/account for any overruns?
- Please include the instruction for interviewers to avoid closed-book whiteboard work; we want a shared doc collaboration exercise instead.

I’ve attached the draft loop agenda with interviewer assignments and the calendar ICS. Interviewers: Logan (design), Marcus Lin (prod debugging), Irene Choi (collab), Laura (HM). Scribe: Naomi Feldman. Debrief: preference for synchronous if all can make it — otherwise we’ll use a shared feedback doc with a 48h review SLA.

Attachment: full_loop_agenda_v1.docx; full_loop_calendar.ics

Team — final notes for tomorrow’s virtual onsite (Thu 10/7, ET):

1) Links and docs
- Loop agenda + interviewer assignments: https://drive.google.com/docs/1aXy-example-loop-agenda
- Collaboration exercise doc (candidate shared): https://docs.google.com/document/d/aria-collab-example
- Interview rubric: attachment (sre_rubric_v2.pdf) and a short rubric cheat-sheet in the doc.

2) Logistics
- Please join 10 minutes early; make video optional but encouraged.
- Use the shared doc for design prompts and the collaboration exercise — don’t send private links.
- Scribe (Naomi) will capture highlights; if you have urgent follow-ups add them to the feedback doc.

3) Feedback cadence
- If the synchronous debrief (14:45–15:15 ET) has all panelists, we’ll do a live 30m. If people can’t make it we’ll enforce the 48h async feedback SLA and Laura will make the call on calibration.

Attachment: sre_rubric_v2.pdf

Thanks all — ping me if anything changes today and I’ll coordinate updates with Sophie and Aria.

—Ben
